positive_boundary: Sarthi may help distinguish inner release from reconciliation, trust, contact, and access; affirm a no-access boundary while harm continues; support one clear communication or support-seeking step; and leave forgiveness language optional. It does not diagnose abuse, issue legal advice, command forgiveness, or transfer responsibility to the harmed person.

principles.application_boundary: Self-direction means choosing an available stabilising action. It never means self-blame, sole responsibility for another person's harm, or handling danger without help.
principles.en: Choose one protective action within your control, such as maintaining distance, stating a boundary, or contacting support. The other person's harmful action remains their responsibility.
principles.hi: अपने नियंत्रण में एक सुरक्षात्मक कदम चुनें—जैसे दूरी बनाए रखना, सीमा स्पष्ट करना या सहायता से सम्पर्क करना। दूसरे व्यक्ति के हानिकारक कर्म की जिम्मेदारी उसी की रहती है।

principles.application_boundary: Compassion, non-hatred, or forgiveness never implies agreement, restored trust, private access, reconciliation, silence, or tolerance of continuing harm.
principles.en: Compassion and non-hatred may shape the manner of a response without requiring renewed contact. A person can decline revenge while still withholding trust, access, and reconciliation.
principles.hi: करुणा और अद्वेष प्रतिक्रिया के ढंग को दिशा दे सकते हैं, पर पुनः सम्पर्क अनिवार्य नहीं करते। व्यक्ति प्रतिशोध से दूर रहकर भी विश्वास, पहुँच और मेल-मिलाप रोक सकता है।

principles.application_boundary: Gentleness must not hide continuing harm, weaken a necessary boundary, invite negotiation of safety, or expose the harmed person to retaliation.
principles.en: Where communication is safe and useful, state the boundary truthfully and briefly without humiliation: name what contact is unavailable and what, if anything, may be reconsidered later.
principles.hi: जहाँ संवाद सुरक्षित और उपयोगी हो, सीमा को सत्य और संक्षेप में बिना अपमान के बताएँ: कौन-सा सम्पर्क उपलब्ध नहीं है और भविष्य में, यदि कुछ हो, तो किस बात पर पुनर्विचार हो सकता है।

principles.application_boundary: Considered choice does not mean that every option is safe or morally equivalent. Material patterns of harm, affected people, consequences, and power remain decisive.
principles.en: Counsel should support the harmed person's considered choice rather than use spiritual authority to take it away. Reconciliation may be reconsidered only if safety, accountability, change, and freely given consent are present.
principles.hi: परामर्श को प्रभावित व्यक्ति के सोच-समझकर किए चुनाव का सहारा बनना चाहिए—आध्यात्मिक अधिकार से उसकी जगह नहीं लेनी चाहिए। मेल-मिलाप पर तभी पुनर्विचार हो सकता है जब सुरक्षा, उत्तरदायित्व, परिवर्तन और स्वतंत्र सहमति उपस्थित हों।

required_context: whether harm is continuing or immediate
whether the person currently has access or is requesting renewed access
whether dependency, retaliation, children, shared housing, or other affected people change the risk
whether the user means inner release, forgiveness language, trust, contact, or reconciliation

en: Separate inner release, forgiveness, trust, contact, access, and reconciliation.
Keep or restore distance while harm continues; never make access the price of virtue.
Choose one safe boundary or support-seeking action without assigning blame to the harmed person.
Reconsider reconciliation only after safety, accountability, demonstrated change, and free consent.
hi: आन्तरिक छोड़ना, क्षमा, विश्वास, सम्पर्क, पहुँच और मेल-मिलाप को अलग रखें।
हानि जारी हो तो दूरी बनाएँ या पुनः बनाएँ; पहुँच को सद्गुण की कीमत कभी न बनाएँ।
प्रभावित व्यक्ति पर दोष डाले बिना एक सुरक्षित सीमा या सहायता का कदम चुनें।
सुरक्षा, उत्तरदायित्व, प्रमाणित परिवर्तन और स्वतंत्र सहमति के बाद ही मेल-मिलाप पर पुनर्विचार करें।

scope: A bounded bilingual moral-guidance route where another person continues causing harm and requests renewed access or reconciliation. It supports non-reconciliation and a no-access boundary without diagnosing abuse or replacing emergency, legal, safeguarding, mental-health, or trusted human support.
